verdict.rationale: Lindy is an AI-agent SaaS, so a versioned public API with a deprecation policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack does not document any versioned Lindy API or deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The MCP and integration docs describe Lindy consuming other products' APIs and MCP servers, not exposing versioned APIs of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
